correctness.rationale: A derivation of L=V⊕Λ²V is uniquely [A 0;B ρ(A)] since Λ²V=[L,L] and Leibniz forces ρ(A). Squaring gives A²=A, ρ(A)²=ρ(A), BA+ρ(A)B=B. On U=im A and W=ker A, ρ(A) has eigenvalues 2,1,0 on Λ²U, U∧W, Λ²W. Thus odd characteristic forces rank A≤1; characteristic two allows all ranks. The free block B is completely described by the eigen-one/kernel spaces and counted by their dimensions. Full rank is r+r(d-r), complementary projectors contribute Gaussian(d,r)q^{r(d-r)}, and the reduced strata are smooth vector bundles over the projector homogeneous spaces. Exhaustive direct-Leibniz and idempotence checks in 4 finite configurations, including GF(4), match the predicted ranks. Limit: no claim about the unreduced scheme or classification of all higher-order derivations.

value.rationale: This is a natural full rank distribution and reduced component classification for idempotent derivations on an infinite family of free nilpotent Lie algebras, not a selected small instance or parameter trick. The sharp jump from two to d+1 components in characteristic two, the maximum-rank increase from d to floor((d+1)^2/4), and the positive-density families with nonabelian non-ideal images expose a meaningful modular boundary of the classical image-ideal theorem. The exact finite-field polynomial gives reproducible arithmetic invariants beyond the usual structural derivation description; it does not claim orbit classification or independent validation.
